# fluwx

**Tag**: mobile

## 简介

The capability of implementing WeChat SDKs in Flutter. With Fluwx, developers can use WeChatSDK easily, such as sharing, payment, launch mini program and etc.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/OpenFlutter/fluwx
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/fluwx
